title: Desenvolvedor full stack sênior php
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior PHP
Somos uma plataforma que ajuda investidores a encontrarem as melhores oportunidades de investimentos. Temos como base a filosofia Buy And Hold (Investimento de longo prazo). Trazemos para nossos usuários informações como: cotações, balanços, comparadores, históricos financeiros das empresas, gráficos, cursos, gerenciador de carteiras, entre outras funcionalidades. Lançada em dezembro de 2020, a plataforma vem tendo um ótimo crescimento, mensalmente já são mais de 18 milhões de pageviews acessadas.
Estamos procurando um desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior para se juntar à nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Manter-se atualizado com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e novas tecnologias. Requisitos Técnicos:
Experiência comprovada como desenvolvedor back-end em PHP;
Experiência comprovada como desenvolvedor front-end em React Native, HTML, CSS e Javascript;
Forte experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (por exemplo, My SQL, Postgre SQL);
Conhecimento avançado em Laravel;
Experiência com integração de APIs de terceiros;
Familiaridade com práticas de segurança web;
Experiência prática utilizando ferramentas de IA (como assistentes de código, geração de testes, análise de código ou automação de tarefas);
Capacidade de utilizar IA de forma crítica e responsável, validando resultados e mantendo qualidade técnica;
Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e comunicação;
Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe;
Conhecimento em Docker, Git, Padrões de desenvolvimento, Repository Pattern, Service Layer, Clean Code, Blade, Filas (Queue) - Horizon, Cache (Redis);
Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe. Diferenciais:
Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações em nuvem AWS (RDS, ECS, EC2);
Experiência com uso de IA aplicada a produto ou automação interna;
Certificações relevantes em desenvolvimento web;
Conhecimento e interesse pelo mercado financeiro;
Já investir ou ter investido em renda variável. Informações Complementares:
Ambiente de trabalho agradável e organizado;
Trabalho 100% Remoto;
Horário flexível. Salário: a combinar
Contrato: Prestador de Serviços (PJ) com pacote completo de benefícios.

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world's biggest problems?

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior data scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis, essa vaga é para você.
Sobre a Tipspace
A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.
Tecnologias do Projeto
Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:
Bancos de Dados relacionais
Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
SQL para consultas estruturadas
Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código Responsabilidades
Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:
Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção. Requisitos
Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:
Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:

As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management

Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:

100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.

Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.

Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.

Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience

Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;

Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio. Diferenciais:

Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + Service Now); Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Our culture isn't something people join, it's something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you're on the fence about whether you're a fit, we say go for it. Let's build something great together.
Must haves
6+ years of experience automating the build, test, and deployment of applications.
4+ years of experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies, specifically Docker and Kubernetes (EKS).
Proven experience with CI/CD** and Ia C tools such as Git Hub Actions and Terraform.
Experience with secrets management using Hashi Corp Vault.
Experience with Kubernetes management tools like Argo CD.
Production operations experience in support of applications and cloud infrastructure.
Experience with the Apache stack (Kafka, Flink, Iceberg) is a plus.
B. S. or M. S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Competencies
Hands-on implementation and development with continuous integration, continuous deployment, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and advanced monitoring tools running on Amazon Web Services, and monitoring the performance and ensure stability.
The services you build will enable seamless deployment and management of cloud-based systems.
You will also design how features should be implemented and help determine the best architecture to use in each situation.
Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with an SRE mindset. Key responsibilities
Write Terraform modules to build and manage Infrastructure as Code.
Architect and implement tooling for all aspects of CI/CD, including secrets management with Hashi Corp Vault, particularly for EKS environments.
Engage with Engineering teams to support application deployments, CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions, and migrations towards Ia C.
Implement enhanced logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions, utilizing tools like Grafana.
Drive architecture discussions and design decisions with a focus on simplicity, maintainability, and reliability.
Manage Kubernetes deployments and configurations using Argo CD.
Advocate for transparency and knowledge sharing across the organization through regular blogs, reveals, and pull requests.
Create clear, thorough documentation that sets up other teams for self-guided success.

title: Desenvolvedor .net
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor. NET Core
⸻
Sobre o Wite Group / Wite Tec
O Wite Group, por meio da Wite Tec, é uma empresa orientada à construção de produtos digitais com impacto real no negócio. Atuamos com alto nível de responsabilidade técnica, foco em eficiência operacional e compromisso com entrega consistente em ambiente de produção. Não somos uma empresa de experimentação superficial — valorizamos profissionais que assumem ownership, tomam decisões e sustentam sistemas críticos com qualidade e previsibilidade.
⸻
Sobre a posição
Buscamos um desenvolvedor. NET Core com forte capacidade de execução, que saiba transformar demandas em soluções funcionais, escaláveis e seguras. O profissional será responsável por atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas em produção, com autonomia para propor melhorias e responsabilidade sobre o que entrega.
Não buscamos apenas alguém que "sabe programar", mas alguém que resolve problemas reais, entende impacto de negócio e entrega com consistência.
⸻
Responsabilidades
• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações utilizando. NET Core
• Trabalhar com APIs REST de forma estruturada e performática
• Garantir qualidade de código, legibilidade e manutenção a longo prazo
• Participar de decisões técnicas com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade
• Atuar na identificação e correção de problemas em ambiente produtivo
• Colaborar com outras áreas (produto, dados, operações) para entregar soluções completas
• Assumir responsabilidade direta por entregas, prazos e estabilidade do sistema
⸻
Requisitos técnicos (Hard Skills)
• Domínio prático de. NET Core e C#
• Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs REST
• Conhecimento sólido em banco de dados (SQL Server ou similar)
• Entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas (camadas, separação de responsabilidades)
• Experiência com versionamento de código (Git)
• Capacidade de debugar, identificar e resolver problemas reais em produção
• Noções de performance, segurança e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
⸻
Competências comportamentais (Soft Skills)
• Alto senso de responsabilidade (não terceiriza problema)
• Capacidade de execução sem depender de microgerenciamento
• Pensamento crítico e orientação à solução
• Organização e clareza na comunicação
• Maturidade para lidar com pressão e priorização
• Proatividade para identificar melhorias e agir
⸻
Observação final
Buscamos um profissional com alto nível de execução, que entrega, sustenta e evolui sistemas com responsabilidade real. Aqui, resultado prático é mais importante do que discurso técnico.

title: Estagiário de relações internacionais

Atendimento ao cliente e análise de perfil migratório atráves de videochamadas

Jornada de 6 horas por dia (totalmente remoto)
Oportunidade real de efetivação, com aumento salarial, comissões e bonificações por desempenho Requisitos:
Estar cursando Relações Innternacionais a partir do 6o período
Interesse pela área de Direito Internacional, Administrativo e de Imigração Espanhola
Boa comunicação oral e escrita

title: Salesforce software engineer
description:
We are hiring experienced Software Engineers to join our team and build on the Salesforce platform. These are hands-on engineering roles — you will be writing code, designing solutions, and shipping features across a large, mature codebase. We are not looking for administrators or declarative-only builders; we need engineers who think in code and architecture.
We're hiring across both UI/Frontend and Backend/Platform specializations, and you'll work on a production Experience Cloud site built with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Bootstrap, supported by a robust backend of Apex services, integrations, and asynchronous processing.
What You'll Work On
Frontend / UI Engineers will focus on:
Building and maintaining Lightning Web Components within an Experience Cloud site serving external users
Working with Bootstrap-based styling and responsive layouts alongside the LWC framework
Designing component architectures that are performant, accessible, and maintainable at scale
Integrating frontend components with Apex controllers, platform events, and real-time data flows Backend / Platform Engineers will focus on:
Designing and building Apex services, triggers, and automation across a complex data model
Implementing and maintaining asynchronous processing patterns including Queueable Apex, Batchable Apex, and Platform Events
Working with the Connect API and other Salesforce platform APIs
Building and supporting Mule Soft integrations for document processing and connectivity to external systems
Ensuring governor limit compliance, bulkification, and performance optimization across high-volume operations All engineers will contribute to code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline— we value a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and software engineering principles
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a meaningful portion spent writing code on the Salesforce platform (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Visualforce)
Demonstrated experience building large-scale applications — you've worked in codebases with significant complexity, not just small apps or proof-of-concept projects
Experience building cloud-native or cloud-hosted applications — you understand multi-tenant architecture, API-driven design, and the tradeoffs of building on a managed platform
Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) — you actively use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review, and you understand how to validate and guide AI-generated output effectively
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), testing strategies, CI/CD, separation of concerns, and clean code practices Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud (Community Cloud) site development
Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC) in production
Experience with Mule Soft (Anypoint Platform, API-led connectivity, Cloud Hub)
Familiarity with Platform Events and event-driven architecture on Salesforce
Experience with Batchable and Queueable Apex patterns for high-volume data processing
Working knowledge of the Salesforce Connect API
Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II (valued but not required — we care more about what you can build than what you've passed)
Experience with Bootstrap or similar CSS frameworks in the context of LWC development
Familiarity with document processing pipelines and integration patterns

title: Especialista em processos industriais

Familiaridade com ISO 13485;
Experiência em ambientes produtivos de alta precisão. Benefícios:

Parceria com a faculdade Esamc, desconto nas mensalidades de Graduações, Tecnólogos e MBA;
Seguro de vida.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.
O foco principal é no frontend — React, Next.js, performance, arquitetura de componentes, boas práticas. PHP existe na stack, mas a prioridade aqui é quem domina o mundo JS/TS moderno.
O que você vai fazer
→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário
O que esperamos
→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)
→ Capacidade de liderar e fazer code review com autoridade técnica no frontend
→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código
→ Experiência com Type Script, boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito
→ Experiência em estruturar processos em times sem metodologia definida
→ Comunicação clara e maturidade pra dar feedbacks difíceis
Remuneração: A combinar
100% Remoto
---
ATENÇÃO — Como se candidatar
Não aceitamos candidaturas por aqui.
As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.
Candidate-se agora:
Leva cerca de 15 minutos. Você sabe na hora se avança.
---

A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !Quais serão suas atividades;Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais). O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso " Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems What we are looking for:Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.
Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment What we offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)

description:
ITTConnect is seeking aSenior Mainframe Automation Engineer (z OS Automation and CA OPS/MVS)to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil.All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).We are seeking an experiencedSenior Mainframe Automation Engineerto lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning fromCA OPS/MVStoIBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OSand fromCA Automation PointtoIBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM). The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position doesnot impact application developmentbut will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.Job responsibilities :
Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.Key skills :
Mainframe Operations Expertise:Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS:Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
TSO and ISPF:Proficient in using these tools for system management.
JCL:Strong skills in Job Control Language.
REXX Programming:Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
System Automation Policy Database (PDB):Working knowledge required.
Migration Experience:Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
Net View for z/OS:Experience in implementing and using this product.Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:
Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer:
Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção. O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C);
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos. Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início. Benefícios que oferecemos:

title: Technical ai project manager / qa lead
description:
ABOUT CONTENTJET
Content Jet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals.
Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, Open Claw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.
THE MISSION: SHIELD OPERATIONS AND PERFECT THE AI DEPLOYMENTS
Content Jet is undergoing a massive transformation to become a fully AI-native agency. While our AI Agent Architect and Automation Engineer build the complex infrastructure, we need a ruthless tester and operational bridge.
Your mission is simple: ensure that no buggy agent, broken n8n workflow, or hallucinating AI ever reaches the CEO, our team, or our clients. You are the ultimate gatekeeper of quality and the translator between our agency operations and our engineering pod.
THE ROLE
You are the operational anchor of our AI transformation. You will not be writing the Python code or building the complex multi-agent architectures, but you must be technical enough to understand how they work, how they connect via APIs, and exactly how they break.
You will audit our existing manual operations, write clear documentation detailing exactly what the AI needs to do, and hand those requirements to the engineering team. Once they build an agent (deployed via Open Claw ) or an automation (via n8n ), your job is to try to break it. You will test every edge case, log every bug, and manage the feedback loop until the system is bulletproof and ready for the agency floor.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Audit and Document: Deep-dive into our current agency operations, mapping out every manual click, copy-paste, and email to create clear requirements for the AI Architect.
Relentless QA & Testing: Act as the \"human-in-the-loop\" during the testing phase. You will vigorously test AI agents across Slack, Monday.com, and web interfaces to find edge cases, hallucinations, and logic failures before deployment.
Bug Reporting & Triage: Manage the development pipeline. When a VAPI voice agent fails a creator screening or an n8n webhook drops data, you write the detailed bug report for the engineering team.
Prompt QA: Review the outputs of AI workflows (such as personalized creator briefs or automated emails) to ensure the tone, accuracy, and brand alignment are perfect.
Protect the CEO: Fully own the testing and troubleshooting phase so the CEO can focus purely on running the agency, completely removed from software QA.
Team Training: Once an AI agent or automation is finalized, you will write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and train the Content Jet staff on how to use the new system. MUST-HAVE SKILLS
Exceptional QA Experience: You have a proven track record of testing complex software, automations, or AI workflows and documenting bugs clearly.
Technical Literacy: While you aren't writing production Python, you understand how APIs work, what webhooks are, and the basics of n8n and LLM prompt logic. You know why systems break.
Hyper-Organization: You are a master of project management tools (Monday.com, Jira, Linear) and can manage multiple concurrent AI deployments without dropping the ball.
UGC / Agency Understanding: You understand how a creative agency functions—what a creator brief is, how outreach works, and the level of quality clients expect.
Flawless English Communication: You will be writing detailed technical tickets, testing client-facing AI outputs, and writing internal training guides. NICE-TO-HAVE
Previous experience working in an AI startup or working directly alongside AI Engineers.
Hands-on experience with Monday.com, n8n, or testing chatbot/agent outputs.
Background in UGC, creator operations, or content production workflows.
Aligned with North American time zones (EST/PST). WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Within 30 days: You have fully audited our top 5 manual workflows, created a clear roadmap for the engineering pod, and established a formalized bug-reporting and testing system.
Within 60 days: You are rigorously testing the first wave of deployed AI agents. You have successfully caught, documented, and helped resolve critical edge cases before they impacted agency staff.
Within 90 days: You completely own the AI product lifecycle. The CEO is entirely removed from all QA and troubleshooting, and manual work across the agency is rapidly decreasing thanks to your smooth deployments.

title: Ai agent architect / builder
description:
ABOUT CONTENTJET
Content Jet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals. Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, Open Claw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.
THE MISSION: REPLACE MANUAL WORK WITH AI AGENTS
Content Jet is on a mission to become a fully AI-native agency. That means every workflow that currently requires a human clicking, copying, pasting, searching, emailing, or following up manually should be handled by an AI agent instead. We're not looking for someone to build chatbots — we're looking for someone who can systematically identify manual bottlenecks across our operations and replace them with autonomous agent systems that run 24/7 without human intervention.
This includes: creator discovery and vetting, outreach campaign creation, brief reading and task assignment, content pipeline management, quality control, reporting, team notifications, client communication, and any repetitive operational task that currently eats human hours.
THE ROLE
You are the person who designs and builds complete AI agent systems from concept to production. You will own the architecture of multi-agent pipelines — defining agent roles, communication flows, tool integrations, and orchestration logic.
You will work extensively with Claude Code CLI to build, test, and iterate on agent systems directly from the terminal — writing production-grade code, managing project structures, and leveraging Claude's coding capabilities for rapid development. You will use Claude Cowork with MCP connectors to orchestrate complex workflows that read from Monday.com, discover creators on Tik Tok/Modash, create Instantly campaigns, produce personalized documents, and coordinate across Slack channels — all without manual intervention.
You will deploy agents via Open Claw, our open-source AI agent gateway, to make them accessible across multiple platforms (Slack, Telegram, web) with full DM and group chat support, tool management, and multi-model routing.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Systematically audit Content Jet's operations to identify every manual task that can be replaced by an AI agent or automation
Design and build multi-agent systems that fully replace manual workflows: creator sourcing, outreach, qualification, brief processing, campaign management, reporting, and team coordination
Use Claude Code CLI as your primary development environment to build, debug, and ship agent systems rapidly from the terminal
Build complex automation workflows using Claude Cowork with MCP connectors — orchestrating Monday.com, Tik Tok, Modash, Instantly, Google Drive, Slack, and other platforms into seamless, zero-touch pipelines
Deploy and configure agents via Open Claw for multi-platform delivery (Slack, Telegram, web interfaces) with DM and group chat support
Architect agent communication flows, decision trees, tool-use schemas, and escalation logic within the Open Claw gateway
Integrate agents with external tools via APIs and MCP connectors (Monday.com, Modash, Tik Tok, Instantly, Apollo, Apify, Firecrawl, Eleven Labs, Creatomate, etc.)
Build AI-powered creator sourcing and outreach pipelines — from Monday.com brief reading through creator discovery to Instantly campaign creation, with personalized Word document guides produced automatically for team members
Build AI voice agents using VAPI + Claude + Twilio/Telnyx for creator and lead qualification, replacing manual phone screening
Write production-grade Python agent code with proper error handling, logging, Slack integration (multi-channel), and monitoring
Design prompt systems at the systems level — agent instructions, Open Claw tool configurations, Claude Cowork task definitions, output parsing, and quality control
Create CLAUDE.md project files for agent codebases following enterprise-grade standards (security, design philosophy, code organization)
Continuously look for new manual processes to automate — the goal is zero manual work for repetitive tasks MUST-HAVE SKILLS
Python (production-level, not just scripting) — you write code that runs in production 24/7
Deep prompt engineering — system-level agent instructions, multi-step reasoning chains, tool-use orchestration, not simple chatbot prompts
Claude Code CLI proficiency — comfortable building, testing, and shipping entire projects from the terminal using Claude as a coding partner
Claude Cowork experience — ability to design and execute complex multi-step workflows using MCP connectors to orchestrate across platforms
Experience with Open Claw or similar AI agent gateways/orchestration frameworks for multi-platform agent deployment
API integration experience (REST, webhooks, OAuth, API chaining) — you can wire any two systems together
Experience building multi-agent or multi-step AI systems (Crew AI, Auto Gen, Lang Graph, or custom builds)
Strong understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) — how to connect Claude to external tools, databases, and services
Understanding of agent design patterns: Re Act, tool-use, delegation, human-in-the-loop, autonomous decision-making
Experience deploying agents across multiple platforms (Slack bots, Telegram bots, web chat)
Strong English communication (written) — you'll write agent specs, workflow documentation, and team guides NICE-TO-HAVE
Familiarity with n8n (self-hosted) for workflow automation alongside agent systems
Background in UGC, creator economy, influencer marketing, or content operations
Experience with Monday.com API, Modash, Tik Tok Creator Marketplace, or similar creator tools
Experience configuring Open Claw for multi-platform deployment with tool availability management and config troubleshooting
French or Arabic language skills (for MENA market projects) WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Within 30 days: You've audited our current manual workflows, deployed your first multi-agent system via Open Claw integrated with Slack, and shipped a working creator sourcing automation using Claude Cowork with MCP connectors.
Within 60 days: You've replaced at least 3 major manual workflows with autonomous agent systems. You're independently designing agent architectures using Claude Code CLI and deploying them via Open Claw with minimal direction.
Within 90 days: You're leading AI agent delivery across 3–5 concurrent automation projects, have eliminated the majority of repetitive manual tasks in our operations, and are training team members on agent-powered workflows. Manual work at Content Jet is the exception, not the norm.

title: Senior business analyst – supply chain
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Manager, corporate development - m&a origination & deal sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.comThe Role
The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes
Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies
At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements
Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U. S., and Portugal.
Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Gerente De Loja (Vaga Temporária)
description:
A CK é uma marca norte-americana fundada em 1968 na cidade de Nova York, e que manteve sua iconicidade e atemporalidade até os dias atuais. Este nome se expandiu ao redor do mundo, e por isso hoje está presente em vários países, inclusive no Brasil.

Nosso propósito é “impulsionar a moda para o bem”, além de termos como visão “sermos a marca de fashion lifestyle mais admirada do mundo!”. Para isso, temos alguns valores como individualidade, integridade, paixão, parceria e responsabilidade.

Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! title: Executivo(A) Comercial | Campinas, São Paulo | Liora Energia
description:
Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo

Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.

Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
  • Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
  • Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
  • Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.

O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
  • Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.
  • Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados.
  • Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil

Nossa Proposta de Valor:

  • Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho.
  • Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação.
  • Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento.

E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?

Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!

#VemPraLiora #EnergiaSimples #Transformação #VendasComPropósito

title: Desenvolvedor De Negócios
description:
Formerly Bosch Video Systems, IQSIGHT has more than 60 years of engineering expertise. Delivering intelligence-first video security that helps organizations see clearly, understand context in real time, and act with confidence, IQSIGHT transforms video into actionable insight so leaders can make better decisions, earlier. IQSIGHT offers a proven portfolio of NDAA- and TAA-compliant video solutions, including FLEXIDOME, AUTODOME, and MIC cameras, supported by more than 600 patents and designed to perform reliably over the long term.

Missão da Posição

Impulsionar de forma sustentável o crescimento do negócio, aumentando as vendas no vertical ou país sob sua responsabilidade por meio da geração de demanda e da identificação de oportunidades de projetos. Isso inclui o desenvolvimento de novos negócios, o engajamento antecipado com grandes clientes finais e grupos de influência, bem como uma atuação estratégica junto a grandes integradores de sistemas e às suas necessidades, com o objetivo de atingir as metas orçamentárias estabelecidas. Adicionalmente, apoiar o desenvolvimento da estratégia de canais e garantir sua correta implementação.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o foco de desenvolvimento de negocio para os verticais chave, assegurando acompanhamento contínuo e geração de demanda.
  • Gerar, acompanhar e ganhar oportunidades de projetos, participando ativamente no trabalho de especificações e posicionar as soluções da empresa como primeira opção de compra por parte dos clientes.
  • Gerir a relação técnica e comercial com usuários finais e influenciadores chave, apresentando e trabalhando em soluções com todas as partes relevantes.
  • Identificar e trabalhar estrategicamente com decisores e influenciadores locais, desenvolvendo e implementando planos de influência que assegurem a preferencia pelas soluções da empresa nos verticais foco.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de objetivos de vendas, aumentando a participação da empresa com os cleintes atuais e desenvolvendo novos clientes potenciais.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e dar seguimento a estratégia comercial para a carteira de clientes definida.
  • Realizar visitas regulares a clientes e trabalhar o portfólio de acordo com o perfil do cliente.
  • Dar seguimento continuo ao pipeline de projetos com cada um dos clientes designados, corrdenando ações conjuntas para assegurar o avanço e conclusão.

O perfil ideal inclui:

  • +5 anos de experiência em Business Development, desenvolvimento de mercado ou vendas técnicas em áreas relacionadas em sistemas de vídeo
  • Formação universitária , preferencialmente em Engenharia Eletrônica, Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas similares.
  • Idiomas: Português: Nativo / Inglês: Intermediário / Espanhol: Intermediário

Conhecimentos técnicos importantes:

- Sólido conhecimento em sistemas de vídeo e soluções de videomonitoramento

- Experiência com infraestrutura de IT, redes e sistemas de dados

- Conhecimento em Data, Data Base e dashboards

- Familiaridade com sistemas de segurança eletrônica

- Noções de cibersegurança

Buscamos alguém curioso, orientado a resultados e com visão estratégica , que goste de construir relacionamentos, identificar novas oportunidades de negócio e impulsionar soluções tecnológicas no mercado.

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We are looking for a highly talented and self-motivated Network Specialist to join us on our journey to advance the world of technology through innovation and creativity.

Join our Global Deployment Services team—a hands-on technical engineering group responsible for executing network changes across a globally connected infrastructure. We specialize in data center, routing & switching, WLAN, IPT, security, and contact center technologies. If you're passionate about deploying and maintaining enterprise-grade networks and thrive in dynamic environments, we want to hear from you!

  • Ensure SLA compliance and maximum uptime
  • Mentor team members and contribute to process improvements
  • Maintain test environments and support multi-geo deployments
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance customer satisfaction

Tech Stack & Tools

  • Networking: Cisco (Routers, Switches, Meraki), Arista, Aruba
  • Wireless: Cisco & Aruba WLAN appliances
  • Optimization & Monitoring: Riverbed, Bluecoat, Infoblox, F5
  • Protocols & Services: DNS, DHCP, IPAM, VLAN, STP, VTP, EtherChannel

Qualifications

  • Solid hands-on experience in large-scale enterprise network environments
  • Strong expertise in Cisco Meraki (MS, MX, WLC/AP)
  • Solid understanding of Layer 2 technologies and IP addressing schemas
  • Experience with OS upgrades and troubleshooting across vendor devices
  • Familiarity with cloud or SDN technologies is a plus
  • Advanced english

Soft Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Strong documentation and customer handling skills
  • Ability to perform under pressure and drive continuous improvement

Certifications Preferred

  • ITIL v3
  • CCNP
